limitations: Conditional numerical-randomization uncertainty given all frozen trained proposals; not training-population inference.
RQMC replicate t intervals and Bonferroni family coverage are approximate, not exact finite-sample guarantees.
Numerical replicate SE does not cover private-channel or outer-GH systematic integration error.
Sym g/offdiagonal cancellation is imposed by reflected state sampling and full observation enumeration; zeros are implementation checks.
H/B diagonal entries and candidate differences are computed from full weights, not assigned old exact-proposal coefficients.
Positive estimated sym h and a reported b/h are not positive-definiteness, optimum, shrinkage, or global certificates.
Raw b/h is not interpreted as a stationary branch through independence when its anchor gradient may be nonzero.
Raw versus sym compares explicit reflection averaging of the same trained density; it also changes the mixture representation.
Prediction-tolerance success is a predefined numerical tolerance, not a Taylor remainder theorem or risk equivalence.
Negative-chain symmetry checks do not add an independent environment; numerical replicates do not add training repeats.
Missing/nonfinite/wrong-R inputs remain unresolved slots without reducing the primary family size or replacing seeds.
Only bound JSON statistics/metadata are read; particle arrays, NPZ files and model kernels are not inspected or recomputed.
summary.completion_status_scope: Complete expected primary/raw/coefficient/density slots plus recorded provenance and cost identities; density qualification failure itself never excludes an output.
summary.independence_basis: SHA-bound producer CONTRACT/FREEZE/MANIFEST, common proposal/coefficient freeze links, actual BANK/COMPLETE proposal records and all16 BANK/RNG entropy tuples; sample correlation is not evidence of independence
summary.residual_SE: sd((D_r-P_r)/t^2, ddof=1)/sqrt16, preserving paired index and incidental cross-stream covariance

primary_family.quantities: 12 sym candidate differences D and12 sym residuals (D-P)/t^2
primary_family.SE: sampleSD of16 complete randomization values / sqrt16
primary_family.residual_pairing: independent coefficient and validation streams, paired by randomization index; preserve coefficient component covariance
primary_family.prediction_precision_gate: whole residual/t^2 simultaneous interval contained in[-.01,.01]
primary_family.meaning_of_gate: fixed numerical prediction tolerance, not strict Taylor-bound theorem or risk equivalence

policy.raw_control: all24 raw contrasts and signed odd/even decomposition descriptive means/SE only; no selected p-values
policy.coefficient_reporting: full g,H,B and raw offdiagonals; sym h=tr(H)/3,b=tr(B)/3; ratio b/h reported only with positive estimated h and delta-method numerical SE; not certified global/local optimum
policy.uncertainty_scope: conditional on all frozen trained proposals; R measures numerical randomization, not number of proposal-training repeats
policy.symmetry_scope: antithetic local-state coupling plus exact state enumeration imposes g/offdiag cancellation; zeros are implementation checks, not new empirical discoveries
policy.missing_or_failure_rule: all expected slots retained; no diagnostic/risk/pass-based inclusion; missing primary cells remain unresolved, no replacement seeds or increased budgets

nonfinite_archive_encoding: nonfinite inputs are retained as {nonfinite_input_value: string}; unresolved cells are not imputed
